articles.title: LO:TECH raises $12 million to expand crypto trading into U.S. and Asia
articles.description: LO:TECH is betting on round-the-clock tokenized stock trading but didn’t say if it trades them now; a WFE study found stock exchanges still set prices.

articles.title: Binance net outflows reach $5.3 billion after record hack. CEO says recovery underway
articles.description: Nearly $11 billion left the exchange over 46 hours, although CEO Richard Teng said hourly deposits were beginning to exceed withdrawals.

articles.title: Bitcoin is breaking a midterm election pattern going back to 2014
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 3, 2026

articles.title: ETHGas wants to bring Wall Street to public Ethereum by selling advance block reservations
articles.description: But there’s a catch: validators that fail to deliver on their commitments currently face no financial compensation requirement under the service.

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies after dip to $76,300 as ETF outflows and midterm elections weigh on crypto
articles.description: Bitcoin edged up 0.2% to around $76,900 since midnight UTC as spot ETFs lost $399 million for a second day and Binance customers pulled a net $4.72 billion.

articles.title: Liquid’s bitcoin IOUs are fully backed again after a $320 million exploit
articles.description: A final 250 BTC transfer closed the hole left by September’s bug, but the federation behind the network still hasn’t said who paid to fill it.

articles.title: Tether holds 150,000 bitcoin worth $11.5 billion, CEO Paolo Ardoino says
articles.description: Ardoino didn’t say where the extra coins sit. Holdings outside USDT reserves, such as Tether’s investments, wouldn’t appear in the report.

articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin faces fifth weekly loss as midterm elections weigh on markets
articles.description: A fifth straight weekly decline would mark bitcoin’s joint third-longest losing streak, as oil rebounds and Apple’s margin warning adds to investor caution ahead of the U.S. midterms.

articles.title: North Korea denies role in $6.4 billion Binance hack after FBI points to TraderTraitor
articles.description: The high-profile denial follows FBI alerts identifying North Korean-controlled wallet addresses tied to the largest cryptocurrency exploit in history.

articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin pledges to cover all user losses after near $40 million hack
articles.description: Partners like Tether, Circle, and Chainalysis helped freeze $11M of the stolen assets.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s latest chart signal looks a lot like the ones before its big crashes
articles.description: The Guppy Multiple Moving Average bands signal a bearish momentum, even as seasonality and post-midterm history lean bullish.

articles.title: Binance has spent half its SAFU bitcoin, about $580 million worth, data shows
articles.description: The user protection fund now sits below the $800 million level that Binance’s own rules say triggers a top-up, and the exchange hasn’t said when it will refill it.

articles.title: Bitcoin miner Cipher posts $31 million profit as AI pivot begins
articles.description: The company's revenue dropped 63% in the third quarter, while a $127 million accounting gain helped turn an operating loss into a reported profit.

articles.title: Arbitrum’s council moved $30 million of Binance hack funds without the hacker’s key
articles.description: A 12-person committee briefly rewrote one of Arbitrum’s core contracts to spend from an address it held no key for, then put the code back. It’s the second time this year.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops below $77,000 as chip rout deepens ahead of U.S. midterm vote
articles.description: ZEC tumbled nearly 10% and BNB fell under $700 as the Nasdaq 100 slid into a correction, dragging Asian stocks lower.

articles.title: Big crypto wants the one thing it can’t buy: your vote
articles.description: Our loyalty has been to the technology. This election, the trap is to let the biggest intermediaries claim it for themselves, argues Berkeley Law lecturer Hermine Wong.

articles.title: Bitcoin traders eye post-election rally as exchange outflows point to supply squeeze
articles.description: Bulls are watching short positions, exchange withdrawals and key price levels for signs of a rebound after the midterms.

articles.title: EU entity suspected of losing $106 million from crypto exchange accounts, ZachXBT says
articles.description: The unidentified attacker moved funds through ether, instant exchanges and Monero, but the victim and affected exchanges remain unknown.

articles.title: NYSE tokenized stock plans take shape as four more transfer agents join
articles.description: Broadridge, Computershare, Equiniti and Superstate join the exchange's planned blockchain market, bringing shareholder records and voting services onchain.

articles.title: Brazil’s Mercado Bitcoin halts withdrawals after $40 million drained across 10 chains
articles.description: The Brazilian exchange paused deposits and withdrawals after wallets on at least 10 chains were emptied, days after the $6.3 billion Binance hack.

articles.title: Nvidia, Costco and Nike join pushback against OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
articles.description: Nearly 70% of the companies initially picked for trading have opted out, while 19 firms including Apple, Tesla and Amazon have no disclosed objection as the 30-day response window nears its end.

articles.title: Anthropic swings to third quarter operating loss as compute costs surge ahead of IPO
articles.description: The Claude developer generated $17 billion in quarterly revenue, but higher computing costs resulted in a $567 million operating loss.

articles.title: Standard Chartered debuts tokenized deposits in Hong Kong for corporate clients
articles.description: The bank uses Hong Kong's EnsembleTX system to move deposits between participating banks around the clock, settling in central bank money.

articles.title: Crypto's Washington playbook is working. Don't abandon it now.
articles.description: Regardless of how the midterm elections unfold or which party secures the presidency in 2028, our industry must adhere to its established playbook, writes Solana Policy Institute’s Colin McLaren.

articles.title: Coinbase downgraded at Morgan Stanley; price target slashed 53% on weak earnings outlook
articles.description: Analyst Michael Cyprys cited weak crypto trading activity and doubts about an earnings recovery.
